REASON: The reviewer completely misses the fatal architectural flaw that the failover tools are hosted in the primary region and would be taken out by the very failure they are meant to mitigate, instead focusing only on minor procedural issues like outdated screenshots and tabletop exercise attendance. Because the reviewer approves the proposal contingent only on administrative fixes, they do not kill or fundamentally block it on the correct grounds.
